macros.name: capitalisewords
macros.doc: This command applies a sentence-case command to each word in ⟨text⟩ where the space character is used as the word separator.

macros.name: ecapitalisewords
macros.doc: This fully expands ⟨text⟩ before passing it to \capitalisewords.

macros.name: emakefirstuc
macros.doc: This fully expands its argument before passing it to \makefirstuc.

macros.name: glsmakefirstuc
macros.doc: This command is used by \makefirstuc to perform the case-change.

macros.name: MFUexcl
macros.doc: Add a command to the exclusion list.

macros.name: mfugrabfirstuc
macros.doc: This robust command is provided to emulate v2.07 and its use is discouraged.

macros.name: MFUhyphencapword
macros.doc: This will parse ⟨text⟩ for hyphen characters and apply the case change to each hyphen-separated word.

macros.name: MFUnocap
macros.doc: Locally adds ⟨word⟩ to the exclusion word list for \capitalisewords.

macros.name: MFUsave
macros.doc: Saves the list of exclusions, blockers and mappings to the aux file (if required by some external tool).

macros.name: MFUsaveatend
macros.doc: This saves the information at the end of the document using a delayed write.

macros.name: MFUwordbreak
macros.doc: Markup a character (or command) that should be treated as a word break.
